component: Legacy browser test fixtures and MessageInjection local setup

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The first patch explicitly names Local Folders in existing manifests and moves its account after the real mail account without changing the default. The next patch declares local account/server/identity links in more manifests and changes local MessageInjection to reuse the configured account, creating only when lookup throws. It preserves an existing defaultIdentity and creates the dummy-email identity only when absent. The helper still changes notifications and creates/opens Inbox, so reuse is not absence of side effects or corrupt-profile recovery. Only some manifests supply the dummy email explicitly. No profile, constructor or browser test was run.
title: Legacy test setup reuses explicit Local Folders accounts and existing default identities
